text:
IncidentBot: SEV3 pager: inference-embedder errors spike on thin-client fleet -> >10% 5xx on embed endpoint. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-4321 :rotating_light:
Alex K: ack. jumping on it.
Alex K: seeing KV cache TTL drift on a subset of nodes, TTL set to `900s` but hosts reading `3600s` in logs. starting a scoped rollback to TTL=60s on canary.
Priya S: customer-impact summary: flagged by telemetry. ~120 orgs, peak 30m window, 30% increase in requests that timed out > 750ms. CS notified, crafting triage note.
Michael L: deployed rollback to canary (3 hosts). small improvement on canary latencies. will roll to 20% if green.
Alex K: command used:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/embedder CACHE_TTL=60 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/embedder
```
Alex K: logs show `kv_cache_evict_count` dropped after rollback, but `error_rate` still ~1.2% on some regions. digging into shard ownership mismatch.
Sara P: thanks. can we confirm if any customer data lost? CS says no data loss, just transient failures.
Priya S: confirmed no data loss. customers seeing degraded quality/latency only. Major customers: acme-inc, fleetly.
Michael L: mitigation plan: finish 20% rollout now -> 100% within 30m if stable. also add rate limiter backpressure to client-side as short term.
Alex K: initiating canary -> 20% now. monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/ABCDE/embedder?orgId=1
Alex K: update: 20% -> 100% rolled at +22m, error rate down to 0.3%.
Priya S: good. next: schedule post-incident review and assign action items. who owns RCA?
Alex K: I'll own RCA and root-cause writeup. estimate 3 days (investigate shard allocation and config sync).
Michael L: I'll own automated test + alert (1 day) to catch TTL drift before pager.
Sara P: I'll own customer comms + postmortem draft (0.5 day) and coordinate with CS.
Priya S: I'll create remediation tickets and link to board. proposed action items: [TKT-8976] RCA (Alex K, 3d), [TKT-8977] Add TTL guard and e2e test (Michael L, 1d), [TKT-8978] Config sync job + validation (Priya S, 2d), [TKT-8979] Customer follow-up & FAQ (Sara P, 0.5d).
Alex K: sizing notes: RCA deep-dive may need infra support (estimate +1d if infra involved). Flagging as P1 for next sprint if we see recurrence.
Priya S: prioritization: if fix requires infra changes -> include in quarterly ops backlog (Q3): remediation gating. If purely config/automation, push to sprint next week.
Michael L: thumbs up. will start test today and open PR linking TKT-8977.
Sara P: scheduling postmortem meeting: tomorrow 10:00am PT, 1h. I'll post calendar invite to #incidents and add agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, customer impact, rollout plan.
Priya S: creating remediation EPIC and adding tickets. EPIC: EMB-4321-remediation. linking all TKTs.
Alex K: after RCA I'll propose fallback policy changes: stricter fallback to earlier model variant when embedder errors above 0.5% for >5m. estimate 2d to implement fallback + tests.
Priya S: so final action list for the thread: owners + rough sizes captured, postmortem scheduled, EPIC created, CS informed. we'll re-evaluate priority in roadmap sync but tentatively mark TKT-8978 as Q3 infra item if infra work required.
Sara P: thanks all. adding follow-up checklist to the postmortem doc and closing pager channel once postmortem invite sent. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: closing loop — monitoring will run for 48h, oncall will escalate if error_rate >0.5% again.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-4321 resolved (auto).
